labels.rule: Exact categorical label equality, no assumed ordinal distance, no manual relabeling or title-derived labels
labels.multi_or_ambiguous: Preserve source lists/ambiguity if a later separately versioned source explicitly supplies them; do not fabricate here. Current pinned data has one label per row.
labels.role: Evaluation truth labels and, for optional frozen linear readout only, TRAIN22 supervised targets

transforms.white: Saved alpha0.1 shrinkage: C_reg=0.9*C+0.1*trace(C)/96*I, C unbiased TRAIN22 covariance; (z-mean)@C_reg^(-1/2)

independent_baselines.canonical_counts: Declared MAIN canonical counts; weighted Jaccard=sum min / sum max; no leader/base/sideboard. Use all actual canonical identities for distances, not source names/style.

printed_profile.distance: Equal mean of five within-group mean absolute differences, similarity=-distance. Original known metadata row only; excludes status, ID hashes, hashed traits and source labels.

independent_baselines.train_majority: Most frequent TRAIN22 style; ties lexicographic class order. No held prevalence used.

nearest_neighbors.primary: Five inherited validation queries against TRAIN22, k=1 and3 fixed; no self/family leakage across inherited split
nearest_neighbors.secondary: Optional all27 leave-one-self-out and train22 leave-one-family-out results, explicitly descriptive; no parameter selection or primary pooling
nearest_neighbors.label_agreement: For each query/k, fraction of selected neighbor labels equal to query source style; report every query and aggregate by row, held family and supported class
nearest_neighbors.ties: Sort by descending score then ascending source_index for stable displayed neighbors/prediction. Also report whole equal-score tie sets using absolute tolerance1e-12 and fractional boundary-tie agreement; never silently resolve a tie as evidence.
nearest_neighbors.prediction: Top1 deterministic neighbor source style; top3 class vote with equal weights, ties lexicographic frozen classes; expose tied votes
nearest_neighbors.nulls: Zero-norm/unavailable scores are null with explicit excluded denominators, not zero similarities

optional_ridge.algorithm: Closed-form multi-output ridge regression on one-hot TRAIN22 labels; alpha=1.0 fixed, intercept unpenalized, no optimizer
features: TRAIN22 canonical main-count vocabulary/60 plus one unseen-card-copy-count/60 channel
33 printed-profile coordinates across the fixed five groups
optional_ridge.normalization: Each coordinate standardized with TRAIN22 mean and population standard deviation only; zero TRAIN variance mapped to0 for all rows, explicitly counted. No normalization fit on validation.
optional_ridge.solver: float64: center standardized X and one-hot Y using TRAIN22; W=X_train.T @ solve(X_train@X_train.T + I22, Y_train-Y_train_mean). Predict X@W + Y_train_mean; argmax frozen class order. Objective sum squared errors + 1.0*||W||².
optional_ridge.counts_vocabulary: Sorted TRAIN22 canonical IDs only. Validation-only IDs enter an explicit unseen-copy channel; no label/name-derived features.
optional_ridge.interpretation: Raw and centered z96 become equivalent under train standardization up to numerical error; not independent supporting results. Linear scores are not calibrated class probabilities.

reporting.primary_accuracy: Correct held predictions /5; predictions may be any of all five classes, not restricted to three held classes
reporting.confusion: Full frozen five-class 5x5 count matrix, all supports printed; truth rows with zero support have count0 but recall/F1/accuracy fields null, never scored as0
reporting.macro: Macro recall/F1 over the THREE supported held classes only; all-five-class macro=null/unsupported. Also print row and four-family macro accuracy; no independence claim.
reporting.per_query: Source index, family, source style, prediction, neighbors/scores/ties, support and error; preserve uncertainty and prior-review exposure flags
reporting.no_inference: No p values, significance, confidence intervals, strategy/strength/behavioral-truth claim, majority-vote reviewer truth, or selection of best transform after results

prior_exposure.note: This is a new weak-label question on an already inspected frozen representation. It is separate from score-blind synthetic IR controls and does not make their AST proxy semantic truth.

execution_rule: Root must approve this exact plan before any metrics/closed-form fitting. Freeze runner source and guard/report all attempts; check source/transform/checkpoint hashes before and after. Do not modify old vectors, transforms, checkpoints, imported decks or existing control files.
